notes.title: The "Murder in Paradise" Update is Live!!
notes.notes:
At long last, the [b]Murder in Paradise[/b] update for [i]After School Murder Club!![/i] is [b]live[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574416/aab7bf57e7ac066f1fff13e1a4c44af5cf3d3099.png[/img]

This is my homage to the many, [b]many[/b] anime that have bonus beach episodes, in which the characters run around in swimsuits and hilarity (and fan service) ensues. It has all the screwball comedy, outdated memes, and royalty-free music that you'd expect from [i]ASMC!![/i]... but this time there are two new characters, and [b]bikinis[/b]!

The new scenes should take you around [b]30 minutes[/b] to read through, and there are [b]six new Achievements[/b] to unlock too!

You don't need to buy or install anything separately; just update the game to the latest version, and these bonus scenes will be added in automatically. To access them, [b]get to the end of the story's Second Day[/b]. When you're given the option to head to the beach, take it! (You can also skip the new scenes entirely; useful if you're replaying the game to get different endings.)

Oh, and [b]please pay attention to the content warning[/b] at the start of the new scenes!

As always, [b]thank-you so much[/b] for all the downloads, reviews and streams. [i]ASMC!![/i] started as a dumb test game I made for some friends during lockdown, and I never expected so many people to enjoy it. It's embarrassingly amateur in many ways, but it makes me happy to know it's out there in the world, making people laugh (in one way or another).

There are no further plans for major [i]ASMC!![/i] content, but I'll continue to support the game via bugfixes and other little tweaks for the foreseeable future. And I hope you continue to follow [i]Rabbit, Deer, You[/i] in my future projects too!

[b]Praise the Teeps!![/b]
